The '''''Nova''''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]]-[[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] assigned to [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. It was under the command of Captain [[Naren Bluuis]].
